title: Papertrade (HyperEVM/HyperCore) — BBO-oracle manipulation primitive live but economically closed at current caps; conditional re-open via keeper-trailing OI caps

conditions: official relayer forwards the attacker's signed intents (owner-only relayer allowlist; no self-registration)
attacker accumulates >=25-40M USD/side (ETH) or >=40-55M (BTC) through the keeper's trailing cap refills (~7-9M every 15-30s)
delta hedge (or luck) against the fixed ~4.8bp liquidation trigger during accumulation
keeper keeps refilling; guardian does not retire the market mid-attack

closed_reasons: instantaneous per-side OI headroom (BTC $4.3-9.0M, ETH $7.0-8.6M) is 3-10x below the break-even deployable notional ($25-94M depending on market/move/fee tier)
manipulation round-trip cost from live HL book depth (ETH 15bp $37-45k; BTC 15bp $64-90k) exceeds the payout at current headroom ($7.7-10.4k) under every cost variant
even a zero-slippage fees-only floor is negative for BTC and ~break-even for ETH
opens/closes require the team's two allowlisted relayer EOAs (owner-only registration) - a fresh EOA cannot trade directly
key_facts: Oracle impl unchanged: 0x3997ffc8cbd281d4fc8d0548e505ae2fbbbd985a, 2475 bytes, keccak256 0x75f094dab1fb771fc5ed5953a02be453a5d35dc4878b53a9e6a11c7d9e4e679c (byte-identical to the Oct-15 pre-incident snapshot)

Payout model validated against real closes: pid 874527 logged adjustedPnl 22.948697 vs model 22.9484 (raw 38.157039, fee 0.458974=2% of adjusted); pid 873990 adjusted 0.655196 vs model 0.655448; loss pid 873510 = full raw -1.638169 (no deadband/scaling on losses)
caveats: Book-depth costs from a single 23:10 UTC falling-tape snapshot; costs (and break-even N) scale linearly with depth - calm markets are deeper/higher cost
Accumulation path modeled, not executed (read-only mandate); keeper refill persistence under an adversarial burst is inferred from 40 min of observation + the documented hysteresis rule
Relayer forwarding/screening policy is off-chain and unverifiable from chain - the main non-economic gate
Hedge cost/slippage modeled at 3-9bp of N; actual depends on fee tier and execution
Historical storage reads on the public RPC are load-balancer-inconsistent (off-by-one block); all decisive figures are atomic latest-block reads with keeper-calldata cross-checks
watch_triggers: per-side headroom cap-OI sustained above ~$35M/side (ETH) or ~$70M/side (BTC)
oracle impl slot/hash change (0x75f094da...) or any new deviation/TWAP logic
one_liner: Papertrade's BBO-mid oracle is unchanged and manipulation is still possible in principle, but at today's cap-imposed headroom ($4.3-9.0M/side) every manipulation size is net-negative (ETH 15bp pays $7.7k vs $37-45k cost); the prior $10-22k/cycle figure used a fees-only cost model and double-counted ETH sides - corrected headline E-U now = $0 (high confidence), with a conditional +$15k-180k/cycle re-opening path only if an attacker accumulates $25-100M/side through the keeper's trailing cap refills (bounded by the $4.96M LP bankroll) and the official relayer forwards their intents.
